title: Make a controlled administrative change
goal: Inspect guest privileges and make one reversible configuration edit.
challenge: Inspect identity and sudo rights. Demonstrate a protected-file refusal, keep a metadata-preserving backup, change only the message in /etc/learning-lab/change.conf, compare and validate the result, then restore it. Explain quoting, exit status and redirection ownership.

steps.explanation: This image deliberately grants root through sudo. Confirm you are learner before editing; sudo affects this guest only.
steps.expected: learner is non-root; sudo lists ALL as root. No password is needed.

steps.explanation: Prerequisite: quote the variable as one path. Each && runs the next command only if the preceding operation succeeds. Stop if workspace creation or cd fails.
steps.expected: A new private guest workspace; retain the printed path.

steps.explanation: The current shell performs > before running printf. The protected-file failure has a nonzero status. Read $? immediately. Adding sudo before printf would not elevate this redirection.
steps.expected: Permission denied; the original file is unchanged.

steps.explanation: cp -p preserves owner/mode/timestamps; use these exact lab paths. Keep one backup in the workspace and one beside the fixture.
tee runs with sudo and performs the protected write. diff status 1 means differences; it is not a read failure.
This tiny fixture has one exact data line. This check is not a general configuration parser or Bash-script validation.
steps.expected: The expected line and validated appear.

steps.explanation: Restore the known original and verify exact contents; retain your backup. Never overwrite unrelated configuration.
steps.expected: Compare status 0; restored owner and mode remain root/0644.

hints: The shell opens redirection targets before sudo starts its command.
Use quoted variables and check a failure immediately; a later successful command replaces $?.
Keep a backup, compare one intended change, validate it, then prove rollback.
review: I explained the guest privilege boundary and redirection refusal.
I retained the original and demonstrated a verified rollback.
coverage: Partial LPIC-1 103.1/103.4 introductory shell reinforcement; preparation for 105.2. Guest-only administration; completion records self-review, not verified assessment. No score.
